notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.notes:
Added "Pocket" to see how many credits you have on each machine, Default key "P".

Added perspective cam to Bowling Coins.

Several minor fixes.

Improved performance.

Added new Challenges so head over the challenges room to discover them yourself.

notes.title: Hot fix. 1.3.2.
notes.notes:
Fixed bug in "Coin Adventure" coin pusher that when in "Megaramp"  mode sometimes it crashed the game randomly. 

Fixed icons (Of destroy coin after entering many coins in the same spot) staying after entering the "Pinball mini game" causing sometimes the coin being destroyed rendering the game stuck.

Reduced moon force in "Coin Adventures" so it does not affect the coin when dropping it from the magnet.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 Minor fixes.
notes.notes:
"Coin Adventure" Coin pusher has one of the trap door bouncing a bit more than programmed due to a control change in the last update making harder to activate the spinner.(Fixed).

Several minor fixes and adjustments.

We will keep an eye to new bugs or improvements.

Thank you.

notes.title: Version 1.3 "Take that cover off"
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT

There is a new machine that pushes the limits a bit further in term of coins with more than 600 hundred coins calculated in a given time as such you will need a modern computer with a minimal graphics card (Gtx 1070 and up) to run the game properly, If you computer can't handle the machine please don't play it as is not possible to play with an under power computer. We will try to optimize or make a lighter version if possible but there is now way around when the coins pushes the coins stack.

The machine does not affect the rest of the game, Just don't play if you computer can't handle it.

Warning update.

If you are updating the game, The game will ask you to re start the game the first time to clean some old files up and prepare it for the new version thus also deleting the users files such as Trophies and saved games
but this was necessary to fix some other issues.

Many fixes and improvements.

New machines.

More and more coins.

You know the deal. . . Discover it yourself.

notes.title: Fixes and more options.
notes.notes:
Fixed "Monza" not detecting the coin fall out the machine in some cases.

Fixed coin selection in options menu.

Disabled "Collect & go" when on Jackpot. 

Changed server, Several reasons.

Added "Same coin all game" to coin options. When selected you will play with the same coin even if you load a game with a different coin.

Added "Smooth look" option to game options, This change the look movement when you are standing up, Activated smooth otherwise direct.

Added "Anti aliasing" to graphics options.

Added "V Sync" to graphics options.

More options are coming.

We worked in the load/save code for more stability.

The "Empty Machines" seem to be a error with the game data folder, we are going to confirm it is that and fix it, we may add an option to clear the affected data as a hotfix meanwhile.

Thank you.

notes.title: More fixes and status update.
notes.notes:
Fixed "Monza" machine rotated after exiting to menu.
Fixed "Slots Machine" not adding last winnings after saving.
Some other minor fixes.

The options coins selection is now set up correctly when starting the game however it still has some bugs,  we are going to fix them and we are going to add an option to set the coin as a default for all the games instead of just changing the current game like it is now.So if you choose all coins as default
it will load the coins with that coin no matter what coins the game you load has.In other words you will only play with that coin until you change it again or disable the all coins option.

We have been working hard on the "Empty Machine" some people are having, Unfortunately we have not been able to find the issue, 

Another issue is the "Claw machine" some people are reporting to have one "Claw" flipped or not present, We haven't been able to reproduce it but we have made the limits a bit farther from the glasses.

We are going to still be working on both issues an any new bugs that comes up next.

We are having also some issues, bugs and crashing with the software we are using and we did update the engine and it seems its came with some bugs as well so that doesn't help.

Top 5 scores Imminent wipe out.

We are going to reset the top 5 scores for several reasons, Sorry for this but is necessary and beside will give a change to the new comers for be there as well.  

Thank you and thank you very much for those reporting issues, One thing thought when having an issue
write the general configuration of your Pc like, Windows version, Cpu, Gpu,Ram, etc  that could help like how it happened to pinpoint the issues.

notes.title: Quick fixes.
notes.notes:
"Pot o nickels" coin counter after saving a game would double the amount, Quitting the game would increase the counter astronomically. Thanks to Mr Jelly for reporting it.  Fixed.

Wave prize spawning in the wrong place. Fixed.

"Fake coin" saving fixed.

"Monza machine" sometimes flipped 90 degrees probably Fixed, Need more time to ensure that is totally fixed.

We are working on other reported bugs and focusing on the load/save system to have a flawless experience.

Also the option menu is on the works.

Disabled zoom while standing (Cause other issues).
Fixed issue with ticket not saving.
Some physics optimizations.

Removed "Bloom" option as is not longer an option.

Also we are checking some issues with the load and save system.
